reason: No live/.keep/source guards; git in other worktrees; force removal and rm-rf fallback. Descendants are only same cleanup shells and readonly git diff, no engineering compute.
script_text:
#!/bin/bash
# Remove planned worktrees; preserve unpushed commits (push branch) and tracked diffs (patch).
BK=/home/ubuntu/wt-cleanup-20261009
cd /home/ubuntu/OpenTallas
grep -E '^(DEL_OLD|DEL_CODEX|PRUNE) ' /home/ubuntu/.claude/jobs/724d7460/tmp/wt_plan2.txt | while read tag age p; do
  if [ -d "$p" ]; then
    n=$(basename "$p")
    br=$(git -C "$p" symbolic-ref -q --short HEAD)
    if [ -n "$br" ] && [ -n "$(git -C "$p" log --oneline -1 HEAD --not --remotes 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
      git -C "$p" push -q origin "$br" 2>/dev/null && echo "pushed $br" || { git -C "$p" bundle create "$BK/$n.bundle" HEAD --not --remotes 2>/dev/null; echo "bundled $n"; }
    fi
    d=$(git -C "$p" diff HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$d" ] && git -C "$p" diff HEAD > "$BK/$n.patch" && echo "patch $n"
    git worktree remove --force --force "$p" 2>/dev/null || rm -rf "$p"
    echo "removed $tag $p"
  fi
done
git worktree prune
echo DONE
